description: Create or replace a project deck of slides: for a briefing, findings or a presentation, where dashboards are for exploring. Each slide is a layout and its slots, text as Markdown (**bold**, lists, pipe tables) and charts by name from write_chart / list_charts. Layouts and their slots: title (title, subtitle); section (label, title); text (title, body); columns (title, body, body2, body3); chart (title, chart); chartText (title, chart, body); textChart (title, body, chart); twoCharts (title, chart, chart2); figure (label, figure, body); image (title, image); imageText (title, image, body). An image slot takes a path in the project's Files. Charts draw the deck’s `models` or `scenarios` as in set_dashboard; a chart slot given as { chart, models | scenarios, compare: side | overlay, caption } draws its own. Text can hold a live figure: [[result:metric|scenario=…|model=…|year=…|carrier=…|bus=…|rate=…|base_year=…|scale=k|m|bn|digits=…|unit=…|prefix=…]] (get_results metrics), redrawn after every run. With only name it returns the deck as this input, to edit and send back, and checks it: each slide’s charts run for everything they draw, and figures and images that cannot be found, named. Then show_address("[[deck:Name]]") shows it.

scenarios.description: Scenario names or ids of the open model, "base"/null for the base network. Omit to follow the app’s open scenario.

theme.description: The look of every slide (default paper).

name: set_deck
